title: Tablify workspace configuration
description: Views for JSON/YAML table files in this workspace folder (.vscode/tablify.yaml).

views.description: The first view whose `files` match a data file is used for it.

name.description: Shown when saving a view from the table.

files.description: Glob patterns of the data files this view applies to, relative to the workspace folder. Patterns without '/' match the file name at any depth. Omit to apply to all files.

columns.description: Column order. Written by Save View in the table.

hiddenColumns.description: Columns that are not shown (they can still be filtered).

otherColumns.description: Whether fields that are not in `columns` are shown after them.

readonlyColumns.description: Columns that cannot be edited in the table.

onSave.markdownDescription: Shell command run after a file of this view is saved from an open table, e.g. a formatter: `npx prettier --write ${file}`. Placeholders (shell-quoted): `${file}`, `${relativeFile}`, `${fileDirname}`, `${workspaceFolder}`. Runs in the workspace folder; only in trusted workspaces.

filters.description: Saved filters, offered in the filter bar. Written by Save Filter in the table.

name.description: Shown in the saved filters menu.

query.description: Filter query, e.g. status=draft AND tags=Security.

attributes.description: Attribute name -> definition: how a field is displayed, edited and filtered.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Multi-line plain text; wraps and keeps line breaks.
Structured text, rendered as sanitized HTML.
Single select from `values`; shown as a badge.
Multi select from `values` (a list, or a comma-separated string); shown as badges.
Free list of strings; shown as chips.
true/false, yes/no, 1/0; shown as a check mark.

value.description: Value as stored in the data.

label.description: Column title. Defaults to the attribute name.

values.description: Allowed values, in display order (enum and multienum).
